trophies.name: Nowhere To Run To
trophies.desc: Take out an invading Julianna while playing as Colt.

trophies.name: Nowhere To Hide
trophies.desc: While playing as Julianna, cross Colt off your kill list.

trophies.name: One Perfect Day
trophies.desc: Complete 'Ending It.'

trophies.name: Welcome To Blackreef
trophies.desc: Complete 'The Longest Day.'

trophies.name: Baby, You're a Firework
trophies.desc: Complete 'The Ballad of Ramblin' Frank.'

trophies.name: Egoraphobia
trophies.desc: Complete 'Lost in Transmission.'

trophies.name: Dangerous Liaison
trophies.desc: Complete 'Afternoon Delight.'

trophies.name: An Offer She Can't Refuse
trophies.desc: Complete 'What Wenjies Want.'

trophies.name: Beyond The Horizon
trophies.desc: Complete 'Radio Silence.'

trophies.name: Gooooood Morning, Blackreef!
trophies.desc: Escape to Updaam.

trophies.name: All The Live-Long Day
trophies.desc: Survive all 4 time periods in one day.

trophies.name: Die, Die, And Die Again
trophies.desc: After acquiring Reprise, die for real - or what passes for real in the Loop.

trophies.name: Dead Drop
trophies.desc: Absorb Residuum from a body - like some kind of temporal sponge.

trophies.name: Pieces Of Eight
trophies.desc: While playing as Colt, kill Frank. Or Charlie. Or Fia. Or Wenjie. Or Aleksis. Or Harriet. Egor will do as well.

trophies.name: Ensemble Tragedy
trophies.desc: Kill each Visionary at least once.

trophies.name: Alpha Burger
trophies.desc: Kill Aleksis using his meat grinder.

trophies.name: Power Chord
trophies.desc: Kill Frank using a Slab ability. Take a bow.

trophies.name: Judgement Day
trophies.desc: Kill Harriet with poisonous gas.

trophies.name: Game Over
trophies.desc: Kill Charlie within the rules of Condition Detachment.

trophies.name: Quantum Solution
trophies.desc: Kill all versions of Wenjie within a 90-second period. Simple.

trophies.name: Not-So-Invisible Man
trophies.desc: Kill Egor while he's under the influence of a nullifier.

trophies.name: Didn't See It Coming
trophies.desc: Kill Fia without causing a deadly reaction.

trophies.name: Violent Delights
trophies.desc: Kill Charlie and Fia with a single bullet.

trophies.name: Ghost At The Feast
trophies.desc: Kill 3 targets at Aleksis' party without being seen. Leave Updaam satisfied, knowing you made the party a better place.

trophies.name: Forever Yours
trophies.desc: Infuse a Slab.

trophies.name: Spare No Expense
trophies.desc: While playing as Colt, own all upgrades for a Slab.

trophies.name: Rip And Tear
trophies.desc: As Colt, inflict a truckload of damage to Eternalists during a single use of Havoc.

trophies.name: Blink Of An Eye
trophies.desc: As Colt, transport an enemy onto a mine using Shift.

trophies.name: Fwd: Fwd: Fwd: PAIN
trophies.desc: As Colt, transmit damage over more than 20 meters using Nexus.

trophies.name: Death Is In The Air
trophies.desc: As Colt, achieve 3 airborne headshots on enemies you've launched using Karnesis.

trophies.name: Don't Mind Me
trophies.desc: While using Aether as Colt, kill 3 enemies without alerting nearby enemies.

trophies.name: Dressing Down
trophies.desc: As Julianna, disguise yourself as Colt using Masquerade.

trophies.name: For Every Occasion
trophies.desc: Take 36 different Trinkets into the field with you while playing as Colt.

trophies.name: Spoiled for Choice
trophies.desc: Infuse one of each type of weapon.

trophies.name: The Spice Of Life
trophies.desc: Die every which way as Colt: Drown. Fall. Choke on poison gas. Succumb to fatal depressurization. Get blown up. Shot. Stabbed. Ground up. Fried by a rocket. Oh, and obliterated by a reactor. Fun, right?

trophies.name: Bling Bling Bang Bang
trophies.desc: Equip a loadout worth more than 45100 Residuum.

trophies.name: Full Deck
trophies.desc: Kill a Visionary using a full loadout, without any empty slots or sockets, and escape the map.

trophies.name: Know Your Enemy
trophies.desc: Complete one AEON dossier.

trophies.name: The G.O.D. of O.S.P.
trophies.desc: Enter a map with an empty loadout and kill all Visionaries present. Leave the map. Wash your hands.

trophies.name: Mightier Than The Gun
trophies.desc: Kill all Visionaries in a map - and make it to the exit - without using a gun.

trophies.name: Silent Disco
trophies.desc: Get in and out of a map without being spotted - and kill all Visionaries present.

trophies.name: Only The Guilty
trophies.desc: Kill all Visionaries present in a map and escape without killing any Eternalists.

trophies.name: Clean Sweep
trophies.desc: Kill everyone in a time period and escape.

trophies.name: You Only Die Once
trophies.desc: Finish an entire loop while wearing a ClassPass.

trophies.name: Play It Again, Colt
trophies.desc: After finishing the game once, kill all Visionaries in a map and escape.

trophies.name: Clean-ish Hands
trophies.desc: Kill all Visionaries - and no Eternalists - in a single loop.

trophies.name: A Charlie Montague Game
trophies.desc: Prove you're a real gamer by winning Charlie's Wake Up Challenge, Reward Scheme, the Moxie, Haul-A-Quinn, and the Yerhva.

trophies.name: Cooking With Gas
trophies.desc: While playing as Colt, ignite a gas cloud while someone is inside it.

trophies.name: Sugar Crash
trophies.desc: While playing as Colt, use candy to gain a tactical advantage.

trophies.name: Residual Earnings
trophies.desc: Absorb more than 20000 Residuum in a map.

trophies.name: Chop Chop
trophies.desc: Kill 3 enemies with the machete in 10 seconds.

trophies.name: Old Habits Die Hard
trophies.desc: Enter 0451 at a keypad.

trophies.name: Deathday Suit
trophies.desc: Kill the (mostly) naked character in each map.

trophies.name: Oops
trophies.desc: While playing as Colt, cause someone to fall to their death.

trophies.name: Garbage Day!
trophies.desc: Kill the Garbage Collector and acquire the Fugue slab.

trophies.name: Out Like a Light
trophies.desc: Acquire the HALPS Prototype and disintegrate a Visionary.

trophies.name: Best of Both Worlds
trophies.desc: Use the experimental machine in Karl's Bay to craft a doubly-powerful trinket.

trophies.name: Postmodern Abstractionism
trophies.desc: Kill an Eternalist with a Paint Bomb.
